validation_isolation.description: Optional. Independent eng validation step separate from the planner that authored the packet. PROMETHEUS consumes — no Wayfinder bot. Gate ISO / P2-1.

independent_of_planner.description: True when validator is non-circular vs the planner that wrote the packet

validator_role.description: Operational role label only (e.g. eng_validator). Not a bot identity.

validation_log_pointer.description: Versioned log / receipt path or URI for the validation pass

validation_log_version.description: Version or content-hash of the validation log at pointer
